subject: Action: Update remit & VAT details following Solstice acquisition
messages:
From: Angela Park <angela.park@solstice-cap.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@solstice-cap.com
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Remit + VAT update after Solstice Capital acquisition - immediate action requested

Hi Ben —

Following our closing last week, Solstice Capital has consolidated billing under the new holding entity, Solstice Capital Holdings, Inc. We need Redwood to update remit information, VAT/tax identifiers, and the billing address for all active subscriptions and open invoices. Important details below: 

- New legal name: Solstice Capital Holdings, Inc.
- Remit address: 410 Meridian Ave, Suite 120, San Mateo, CA 94404
- US Tax ID / EIN: 94-1234567
- EU VAT (global finance team uses this for cross-border): VAT-GB999999999
- AP contact: Angela Park (angela.park@solstice-cap.com) / accounts-payable@solstice-cap.com

We have two outstanding invoices with Redwood: R-2026-089 (due 2026-11-15) and R-2026-117 (due 2026-12-05). Please confirm you can reissue both invoices with the updated remit details and VAT information, and advise whether you need any signed forms or additional documentation. I attached a short PDF with our internal instructions for vendors.

We'd like to get the reissued invoices by Friday so our treasury can schedule the payments.

Thanks —
Angela Park
Director, Finance Operations
Solstice Capital Holdings, Inc.
(attachment: Solstice_Acq_Invoice_Instructions.pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Angela Park <angela.park@solstice-cap.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-01T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Remit + VAT update after Solstice Capital acquisition - immediate action requested

Hi Angela —

Thanks for the heads-up and congrats on the close. Looping in our billing and finance leads: Laura Bennett (finance) and Marissa Cole (billing).

Quick answers:
- We can reissue invoices with the new legal name and remit address, and include the VAT number on invoice lines.
- To update vendor records and trigger reissue we need a signed vendor-update form or W-9 (for US EIN) and a VAT registration or declaration for EU VAT handling (if applicable).
- For R-2026-089, I see it marked overdue in our system — can you confirm whether Solstice intends to pay that now or if you need a short payment plan? If you’re paying the overdue one, confirming the date helps us release the reissued PDF and reset accounting notes.

Laura/Marissa — can you advise what fields we need to trigger a reissue and where to store the signed docs? I can also provide a DocuSign link if that speeds up sign-off.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

> On 2026-12-01, Angela Park wrote:
> > Following our closing last week...

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T11:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Remit + VAT update after Solstice Capital acquisition - immediate action requested

Thanks Ben —

Marissa and I will handle the vendor record update and invoice reissue. Required items from Solstice to proceed:

1) Signed vendor update form OR W-9 (EIN confirmation) for the new legal entity
2) VAT declaration (if they expect cross-border VAT treatment) or tax certificate for EU operations
3) Preferred remit method (ACH details or wire instructions) if they want banking info updated

Action plan:
- Marissa to create a new vendor profile under "Solstice Capital Holdings, Inc." and attach the forms to the vendor record (internal task).
- Once documents are attached, finance will reissue invoices R-2026-089 and R-2026-117 with the new remit/VAT fields and push final PDFs to Angela's AP email.
- If R-2026-089 is still unpaid after reissue, we'll earmark it for collections follow-up in 5 business days.

Marissa — assigning the vendor profile creation to you. Please confirm when the vendor is created and whether you want Ben to send DocuSign for signature.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

(attachment: vendor-update-form.pdf)

From: Angela Park <angela.park@solstice-cap.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: finance.director@solstice-cap.com
Date: 2026-12-02T08:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Remit + VAT update after Solstice Capital acquisition - immediate action requested

Hi Ben/Laura/Marissa —

Thanks — attached are the items requested: our signed VAT declaration and a scanned copy of the new EIN letter. 

- VAT number: VAT-GB999999999
- EIN: 94-1234567
- Bank remit method: ACH preferred (we will submit details via secure portal)
- Payment timing: treasury expects to issue payment for both invoices on 2026-12-10 once reissued invoices are finalized. If you can reissue by Friday EOD (2026-12-04 PST), that should be in time.

DocuSign link for the vendor update is here: https://www.docusign.com/solstice/retmit-update/ABC123XYZ

Please reissue R-2026-089 and R-2026-117 to: Solstice Capital Holdings, Inc., 410 Meridian Ave, Suite 120, San Mateo, CA 94404 and include VAT-GB999999999 on the tax section.

Regards,
Angela Park
Director, Finance Operations
Solstice Capital Holdings, Inc.
(attachments: Solstice_VAT_Declaration.pdf)

Thanks team — quick summary and owners: 

- Marissa: create vendor record "Solstice Capital Holdings, Inc." and attach vendor-update-form.pdf + Solstice_VAT_Declaration.pdf. Please mark vendor record as "entity change - acquisition" so procurement tracking picks it up. (Due: 2026-12-03 EOD)
- Laura: reissue invoices R-2026-089 and R-2026-117 with the new remittance address and VAT number; set R-2026-089 to "final reissue" so collections pause until 5 business days after 2026-12-10 if no payment. Please send PDFs to accounts-payable@solstice-cap.com and cc Angela. (Due: 2026-12-04 end of day)
- Ben/Karthik: follow up on payment confirmation on 2026-12-11 and escalate to G&A if payment not posted.

Angela — we'll use the DocuSign link you provided if Marissa needs a signature. I'll confirm once invoices are reissued.

Ben Carter
